topic: Write a Journal Entry about Your First Week(写一篇高中第一周的日记)
title_en: My First Week at Senior High
genre: 日记 / 记叙(journal entry:describe first-week experiences and feelings)
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第一册 Unit 1 Presenting ideas / Writing a journal entry:记录高中第一周的经历与感受。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,刚升入高中一周。请用英语写一篇约80词的日记,内容包括:① 这一周给你印象最深的一件事(如一节课、一次社团活动、或结识新朋友);② 当时发生了什么、你怎么做的;③ 你的感受以及对未来的期待。注意:用第一人称、过去时为主,句子围绕中心、用恰当的基本句型。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua and you have just finished your first week at senior high. Write a journal entry (about 80 words) including: 1) the most memorable thing this week (e.g. a lesson, a club activity, or making a new friend); 2) what happened and what you did; 3) how you felt and what you look forward to.
points: 记叙最难忘的一件事(The thing I remember most this week is …)
说明经过与你的做法(At first … , so I … . Then …)
表达感受与期待(I felt … , and I am really looking forward to …)
第一人称、过去时为主、句子围绕中心、基本句型正确
model_essay:
Friday, 8 September

I can hardly believe my first week at senior high is over! The thing I remember most is my first English lesson. The teacher asked us to introduce ourselves one by one. With butterflies in my stomach, I breathed deeply and said my name. To my surprise, it was the same as the teacher's, and everyone laughed. I felt embarrassed at first, but his kind words made me feel relaxed. Now I feel more confident, and I am really looking forward to the year ahead.
model_translation:
9月8日,星期五

我简直不敢相信高中第一周就结束了!我印象最深的是第一节英语课。老师让我们一个接一个地自我介绍。我心里发慌,深吸一口气说出了自己的名字。没想到我和老师同名,大家都笑了。一开始我很尴尬,但他温和的话让我放松了下来。现在我更自信了,也非常期待接下来的一年。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:难忘的事 / 经过与做法 / 感受与期待
围绕一件事展开、过去时一致、句句相关、行文连贯
基本句型运用得当(SVOO/SVOC/SVP)、词汇准确多样、语法基本无误

required_structure: 点题 The thing I remember most this week is …
经过 The teacher asked us to … . With … , I … .
转折 I felt … at first, but … made me feel … .
收尾 Now I feel … , and I am really looking forward to … .
key_expressions: The thing I remember most is my first English lesson.
With butterflies in my stomach, I breathed deeply.
His kind words made me feel relaxed.
I am really looking forward to the year ahead.

high_sentences: The thing I remember most this week is my first English lesson.
With butterflies in my stomach, I breathed deeply and said my name.
His kind words made me feel a lot more relaxed.
I am really looking forward to the year ahead.

error_pairs.wrong: His words made me to feel relaxed.
error_pairs.correct: His words made me feel relaxed.
error_pairs.note: make sb do sth,后接不带 to 的动词原形。

error_pairs.wrong: I felt very nervously before the speech.
error_pairs.correct: I felt very nervous before the speech.
error_pairs.note: feel 是系动词,后接形容词作表语,不用副词。

error_pairs.wrong: The teacher gave to me a useful book.
error_pairs.correct: The teacher gave me a useful book.
error_pairs.note: give sb sth 双宾语结构,间接宾语前不加 to。
